title: The Meeting on Three Calendars
fact_notes: 登場人物・出来事・観察結果は架空の教材例。実測値・実在資料を主張しない。リンクは制作台帳であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: Three schools in different countries were planning an online meeting for a group of students interested in environmental issues.
sentences.ja: 異なる国の3校が環境問題に関心を持つ生徒向けのオンライン会議を計画していた。

sentences.en: Each school wanted to present a local project and ask questions about the projects of the other participants.
sentences.ja: 各校は地域の活動を発表し、ほかの参加者の活動について質問したかった。

sentences.en: The organizers first chose a date that appeared to be convenient for the teachers involved.
sentences.ja: 主催者はまず関係する教師に都合がよさそうな日を選んだ。

sentences.en: They carefully calculated the difference between the local times before announcing the meeting.
sentences.ja: 会議を告知する前に現地時間の差を丁寧に計算した。

sentences.en: However, one teacher later explained that the selected date fell during a major school examination period in her country.
sentences.ja: しかし後に一人の教師が選択した日が自国の重要な試験期間に当たると説明した。

sentences.en: Another school reported that some students would be observing an important family holiday on the same day.
sentences.ja: 別の学校は同じ日に一部の生徒が大切な家族の祝日を過ごすと報告した。

sentences.en: Even though the time conversion was correct, the original schedule was not practical for all the participants.
sentences.ja: 時差の換算は正しくても元の予定は全参加者にとって実用的ではなかった。

sentences.en: The teachers realized that checking the clock was only one part of planning an international activity.
sentences.ja: 教師たちは時計の確認が国際活動の計画の一部にすぎないと気づいた。

sentences.en: Instead of asking one school to change its own plans, the organizers created a shared calendar with several possible meeting dates.
sentences.ja: 一校に予定変更を求める代わりに、主催者は会議候補日を複数載せた共有カレンダーを作った。

sentences.en: Each teacher marked the dates on which the majority of interested students could reasonably attend.
sentences.ja: 各教師は参加希望者の大多数が無理なく参加できる日に印を付けた。

sentences.en: They also asked about holidays and school activities that were not obvious to colleagues in other countries.
sentences.ja: 他国の同僚には分かりにくい祝日や学校行事についても尋ねた。

sentences.en: After comparing the answers, the teachers agreed on a new date and a shorter meeting format.
sentences.ja: 回答を比較した後、教師は新しい日と短めの会議形式に合意した。

sentences.en: The organizers prepared an alternative activity for students who would still be unable to attend the live meeting.
sentences.ja: 主催者はそれでもライブ会議に参加できない生徒向けに代替活動を用意した。

sentences.en: With permission, participating students could share written summaries of their presentations through their teachers.
sentences.ja: 許可を得て参加生徒は教師を通じて発表の要約を共有できた。

sentences.en: Students who missed the meeting could read those summaries and send questions before the next planned exchange.
sentences.ja: 欠席した生徒は次の交流前に要約を読み質問を送れた。

sentences.en: The teachers did not expect this arrangement to reproduce every aspect of a live conversation.
sentences.ja: 教師はこの取り決めでライブ会話のあらゆる面を再現できるとは考えなかった。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, they believed that offering more than one way to participate was better than treating absence as a lack of interest.
sentences.ja: それでも欠席を関心の欠如と見なすより複数の参加方法を提供する方がよいと考えた。

sentences.en: The project reminded them that international cooperation involves understanding the local circumstances of other people.
sentences.ja: 活動を通じ、国際協力には他者の現地事情の理解が含まれると再認識した。

sentences.en: A technically correct schedule can still create difficulties when important differences are overlooked.
sentences.ja: 技術的に正しい予定でも重要な違いを見落とすと困難を生じ得る。

sentences.en: The teachers learned to treat planning as an ongoing conversation rather than a single mathematical calculation.
sentences.ja: 教師は日程調整を一度の数学的計算でなく継続的な対話と考えるようになった。

questions.prompt: What were the three schools planning?
options: A shared examination in one country.
A sports competition in a stadium.
An online meeting about environmental issues.
questions.explanation_ja: 環境問題のオンライン交流。

questions.prompt: What did the organizers calculate first?
questions.explanation_ja: 現地の時差を計算した。

questions.prompt: Why was the date difficult for one school?
options: It had already held the meeting.
It fell during a major examination period.
questions.explanation_ja: 重要な試験期間だった。

questions.prompt: What problem did the original schedule reveal?
options: The conversion had to be mathematically wrong.
Time conversion alone cannot determine everyone's availability.
Online exchanges must occur at one fixed time.
questions.explanation_ja: 時差だけで参加可能かは判断できない。

questions.prompt: How did the organizers find a better date?
options: They made a shared calendar of possible dates.
They selected a date without consultation.
They asked only one teacher to decide.
questions.explanation_ja: 共有カレンダーに候補日を記した。

options: Dates when all teachers were on holiday.
The time of the first examination.
Dates most interested students could attend.

questions.prompt: What was the alternative for absent students?
options: Receiving a prize without doing anything.
Reading written summaries and sending questions.
questions.explanation_ja: 要約を読み質問を送る。

options: Students could not read any presentations.
Written summaries could not recreate every aspect of live conversation.
A live meeting had no educational value.
questions.explanation_ja: ライブ交流のあらゆる面は再現できない。
見落としたという意味。

options: International scheduling requires dialogue about local circumstances and flexible participation.
Correct time conversion guarantees equal participation.
Schools should ignore holidays during exchanges.
Only students who attend live can learn.
questions.explanation_ja: 現地事情の対話と柔軟な参加方法が重要。
